name: Mobocertinib

own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for heart harm

examples.title: (Concerto) Study of BLU-451 in Advanced Cancers With EGFR Exon 20 Insertion Mutations
examples.why: Sponsor decision, not related to safety concerns

summary: Mobocertinib carries a boxed warning in the United States for heart harm [3]. In addition, a small computer model rather than tests on people rated the drug's risk as high for the liver with a score of 72, and low for the heart with a score of 46 [M]. One clinical trial involving the drug was stopped due to a sponsor decision rather than safety concerns [5].
